Technical grades such as Zinc Oxide Technical or Boric Acid Technical are meant for industrial uses like rubber, ceramics and paints. Technical grades are never offered as a substitute for pharmacopoeial grades."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I get a Certificate of Analysis (COA) before ordering?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes.
